criteria.check: Concrete injected borrowed SDK client call paths for each allocated capability; no service/module import or client construction; no borrowed close/disconnect; inert construction.

Closed inert JSON caller admission/detached results; accessors/proxies/prototypes/symbols refuse without callbacks; trusted identity, policy, scope, budget, schedule generation and approval never model-owned.

Immutable complete intent digest binds action, exact schedule/application identity, original provenance, owner/scopes, generation, policy and explicit timing/overlap/catchup/timezone/immediate/cancel choices. Omitted SDK defaults cannot silently become product policy.

Canonical approval/current authority dependency must bind digest/version and current actor/tenant/scopes; stale/expired/revoked/wrong identity or changed intent refuse before effect. Delegate policy remains external, not owner-equality inference.

Durable application generation/idempotency/budget reservation must authorize exact mutation and reject stale generation/replay/concurrent ownership; state adapter semantics must be concrete or explicitly unqualified. SDK update is not CAS.

Every possible-effect failure, cancelled/expired wait, lost ACK or invalid receipt preserves uncertainty; no automatic retry/refund/replacement/new authority/exactly-once assertion. Accounting/history after authority expiry cannot execute a new action.

Shared absolute lifetime and synchronous monotone deadline publication at each known expiry; challenge parked authorization/reserve/handle/describe/update callback/mutation/settlement/release, clock crossing and abort; late output never released and no late subsequent mutation.

SDK getHandle is non-validating; exact data method/identifier receiver and generation/current descriptor correlation required. Describe→update has no SDK conflict token, so external writers/concurrency remain explicit runtime limits.

Create run-now ALLOW_ALL shortcut must not violate bound overlap; pause/delete do not imply cancellation of existing runs. Explicit running cancellation binds exact workflow/firstExecutionRunId chain; cancellation ACK is not physical termination.

Inspection/list/history uses authorized exact IDs/scopes, bounded traversal/output and explicit incomplete coverage. No fetchHistory-all-then-truncate pretending bounded acquisition; firstExecutionRunId is not current run. No credentials/memo/arguments/raw service errors leaked.

Codec/interceptor/externalStorage work before/after SDK RPC is retained as upstream effects/uncertainty, not prevented by output omission. SDK retry policy and downstream cancellation are not physical-stop evidence.

Full capability mapping only after all approved actions/variants connected; no DTO-only completion, broad namespace list as tenant authorization, or new approval engine. Exact old source/tests retained; all negative/raw evidence, mutants and owned process cleanup recorded.
